record.question: Is there no _________ news than last week's?
record.explanation: Answer D: later. Later is comparative and fits “than last week’s” (D). Independent check: The comparative “later news than last week’s” asks whether news is more recent than the prior week’s. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/later-latter-or-latest-last. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
